availability.slotsNote: Times below are UTC until the public booking page formats them in your timezone.
availability.slotsEmpty: No open slots yet. Add a service and weekly hours.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Your display name is shown on the public booking page. Language is used in the app and in emails we send you.
settings.displayNameHint: Optional. Leave blank to show only your booking link name.
settings.localeHint: English is the default. Turkish is available here.
settings.privacyIntro: You can download a copy of your account and booking records, or delete your account. Deletion removes your name, email, and bio. Appointment times stay so guests can still open their booking link. This is not legal advice.
settings.exportHint: JSON file with your profile and bookings (who, when, service, status). No health records — we do not store those.
settings.deleteHint: This cannot be undone. You will be signed out. The same email can be used later only as a new account.
settings.deleteConfirm: I understand my name, email, and bio will be removed.

errors.NAME_INVALID: Enter a display name up to 80 characters, or leave it blank.
